about: PCA J110 step 1 draft: QuranRevival built from the MSA source. Only the settings the source can already take are filled. Step 2 brings QR's own parts into MSA (the Asma app without sign-in and its manifest and icons, QR's front page, the poster-data fixes); step 3 the one offline worker that takes over and deletes today's qr-app-<version> and qr-* caches; step 4 QR's checks. Not published anywhere until step 5.
later: step 2: name.full.bn once the Owner gives QR's Bangla name (today QR shows QuranRevival in Bangla too)
step 2: hiddenModules can only hide a module nav.js tags with a moduleId (today: general, naturelife, lifeskill, health); QR's Deen, Arabic, Hadith and Dawah links need tags first
step 2: frontPage = QR's own front page, manifest = asma.webmanifest with the asma-* icons
step 3: the worker must take over and delete the qr-app-<version> and qr-* caches of today's QR
step 5: quranrevival.github.io must be in Firebase Authentication's authorised domains (Owner)
